templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from control-loop by the note-writer: panel (a) is a small CNN+MLP diagram and panel (b) a straight chain (predictor to LDO to controller to action) with no return arrow drawn anywhere; this is two-panel, not control-loop.
templates.what_to_learn: A control system is only a control-loop figure if a return path is actually drawn; when the feedback runs through the physical world rather than back into the diagram, either draw a dashed arrow from the output back to the sensing input or file the figure under two-panel or flanked-core instead.
